{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./deep_dae_sdae.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --ntasks=1      -> -n 1
#   --time=4-0:00   -> -t 4d
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 4d --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=mono not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the mono partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem-per-cpu=8000 not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a per-core memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm -J (job name) not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm -e/-o (stderr/stdout files) not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: output routing follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  source /etc/profile.modules

  module load gcc
  module load matlab

  cd ~/deepLearn || exit 1

  # Slurm used: srun ./deepFunction ...
  flux run -n 1 ./deepFunction 4 'DAE' 'SDAE' '128  1500  1500    10' '0  0  0  0' '4_lin_real' 'RICA_sig' "'iteration.n_epochs', 'learning.lrate', 'use_tanh', 'noise.drop', 'noise.level', 'rica.cost', 'cae.cost'" '200 1e-3 0 0 0 0.1 0' "'iteration.n_epochs', 'use_tanh'" '200 0'
fi
"
}
